gloss: early on; promptly; right away; without delay

definitions.explanation: Doing something soon after a certain point in time, without delay or lingering. Often implies leaving or finishing sooner than might be expected.

examples.japanese: {早々|そうそう}に⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{早々|そうそう}に⟦{切|き}り{上|あ}げられた→切り上げる：06979_kiriageru⟧。
examples.english: The meeting was wrapped up promptly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧{早々|そうそう}に⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いて→引く：01978_hiku⟧しまい、⟦{出|で}だし→出だし：30703_dedashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}かった→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: I caught a cold right at the start of the new year, so I got off to a bad start.

notes:
Often follows a time expression or event to mean "right at the beginning of" or "soon after": ⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦{早々|そうそう}→早々：12959_sousou⟧ (right at the start of the new year), ⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦{早々|そうそう}→早々：12959_sousou⟧ (right after arriving). In this suffix-like usage, ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is often omitted.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦{早々|そうそう}→早々：12959_sousou⟧: right at the start of the new year
- ⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦{早々|そうそう}→早々：12959_sousou⟧: right after arriving
- ⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧⟦{早々|そうそう}→早々：12959_sousou⟧: right after opening
- {早々|そうそう}に⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧: to withdraw early
- {早々|そうそう}に⟦{切|き}り{上|あ}げる→切り上げる：06979_kiriageru⟧: to wrap up early

USAGE:
As a standalone adverb ({早々|そうそう}に), it means "promptly, without lingering." As a suffix attached to nouns (X⟦{早々|そうそう}→早々：12959_sousou⟧), it means "right at the start of X" or "soon after X." Note the different reading: {早々|はやばや}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ means "hastily" with a nuance of doing something sooner than originally planned.
